title: feat(triage): let a policy convert a pull request to draft
body:
Closes [CL-XXXX](https://linear.app/abklabs/issue/CL-XXXX)

## What changed

- New Do kind in the pack schema and parser (additive): `convert-to-draft`, with an empty target.
- Executor calls GraphQL `convertPullRequestToDraft` by the pull request's node id. It is satisfied when already a draft, or when the issue timeline shows the App converted it after the head arrived (its `committed` event, or a `head_ref_force_pushed` to it); a head the timeline does not show is converted. Refused once the head moves, like close. No extra grant.
- GitHub App transport: a `/graphql` request names its repository in an `x-corbits-github-repository` header, used to find the installation and stripped before sending.
- Editor, prose and pending Dos list it as "Convert the pull request to draft".

## Verification

- `bun run check`
- `bun run test`: 706 pass, 0 fail
- New tests: converted once per head even after the author marks it ready; timeline arrival by commit and by force-push, and a head the timeline does not show; head-moved refusal; schema and parser accept the kind; transport resolves a GraphQL request's installation from the repository header.
author: TheGreatAxios
commits: feat(triage): let a policy convert a pull request to draft

files.patch:
@@ -56,6 +56,7 @@ const ACTIONS: Action[] = [
       no: [
         { kind: "comment", target: { body: "Please fix CI and link a ticket." }, automatic: false },
         { kind: "request-changes", target: {}, automatic: true },
+        { kind: "convert-to-draft", target: {}, automatic: false },
       ],
       unsure: [{ kind: "labels", target: { from: "list", labels: ["needs-triage"] }, automatic: true }],
     },
